verifications.claim: The Artemis II astronauts successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'waters off San Diego... Pacific Ocean'; R2: 'splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, about 40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego'; R3: 'Splashdown... off the coast of San Diego'; R5: 'Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm the location as Pacific Ocean off San Diego, California.

verifications.claim: The splashdown occurred on Friday evening, April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Floating in the Pacific Ocean on Friday'; R2: 'April 10, 2026... 8:07 p.m. ET'; R3: 'April 1... Flight Day 10'; R5: 'April 10, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources specify Friday, April 10, 2026, for splashdown in evening hours.
